title: Bimodal dataset on Inner speech
description: This dataset provides bimodal EEG and fMRI recordings acquired non-simultaneously during an inner-speech production task. Four healthy, right-handed participants silently produced eight words drawn from two semantic categories (social and numerical) across multiple trials. The dataset aims to support the development of speech prostheses and brain-computer interfaces by enabling multimodal fusion of high temporal (EEG) and high spatial (fMRI) resolution neuroimaging data.
methods_description: Data were collected from four healthy, right-handed participants performing an inner-speech task involving eight word stimuli from two categories (social and numerical), each assessed with 40 trials, resulting in 320 trials per modality per participant. EEG and fMRI data were acquired in separate (non-simultaneous) sessions.
